component.name: T3 Code
component.summary: Desktop control surface for local coding agents

description.p: T3 Code is a desktop control surface for local coding agents — plan, review and run agentic coding workflows from a native window.

ul.li: Agent workspace with worktree / subagent orchestration
Built-in browser / preview, terminal and editor integrations
Electron desktop build distributed as AppImage upstream

description.p: This Flatpak repackages the official x86_64 AppImage from GitHub Releases and runs it sandboxed via Flatpak (no fuse2/SUID on the host — secureblue-compliant).
